init_BaseILTrainer: create a BaseILTrainer instance with a habitat Config object to set up log and checkpoint directories
save_checkpoint: save a model state_dict as a checkpoint file to the configured checkpoint folder
train: implement the train method in a subclass of BaseILTrainer to define the imitation learning training loop
eval_checkpoint: implement the _eval_checkpoint method in a subclass to evaluate a saved model checkpoint with tensorboard logging
load_checkpoint: implement the load_checkpoint method in a subclass to load a model state_dict from a checkpoint file
